static u32 JourneyNativeCampaignEvent(bool32 kanto, u32 count)
{
    if (kanto == TRUE && count >= 1
        && (!RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_2)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_3)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_4)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_SUPER_NERD_MIGUEL)
            || !RegionalFlag(FLAG_GOT_FOSSIL_FROM_MT_MOON)))
        return 17;
    if (kanto == TRUE && count >= 2
        && (!RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_5)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_6)
            || !RegionalFlag(FLAG_GOT_TM28_FROM_ROCKET)
            || VarGet(VAR_MAP_SCENE_ROUTE24) < 1))
        return 18;
    if (kanto == TRUE && count >= 4
        && (!RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_19)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_20)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_21)
            || !RegionalFlag(FLAG_RESCUED_MR_FUJI)
            || VarGet(VAR_MAP_SCENE_POKEMON_TOWER_6F) < 1))
        return 19;
    if (kanto == FALSE && count >= 1
        && (!RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_GRUNT_PETALBURG_WOODS)
            || VarGet(VAR_PETALBURG_WOODS_STATE) < 1))
        return 20;
    if (kanto == FALSE && count >= 1
        && (!RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_GRUNT_RUSTURF_TUNNEL)
            || !RegionalFlag(FLAG_RECOVERED_DEVON_GOODS)))
        return 21;
    if (kanto == FALSE && count >= 2
        && (!RegionalFlag(FLAG_DELIVERED_STEVEN_LETTER)))
        return 23;
    if (kanto == FALSE && count >= 2
        && (!RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_1)
            || !RegionalFlag(TRAINER_FLAGS_START + TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_2)
            || !RegionalFlag(FLAG_DELIVERED_DEVON_GOODS)))
        return 22;
    return 0;
}
